Interface Command

All Known Implementing Classes:
CreateGameCommand, DrawCardCommand, ExitCommand, HelpCommand, InfoCommand, JoinGameCommand, MoveCommand, QuitCommand, RankingRequestCommand, ScrollPlayersCommand, ShowLobbiesCommand, SkipDrawCommand, StatusCommand
public interface Command
Represents a command that can be executed by a client in the game. Implementations of this interface encapsulate a specific action that a player can perform during their interaction with the game.

    • shouldClearLogs

      default boolean shouldClearLogs()
      Indicates whether the log display should be cleared before executing this command. Returns true by default; override this method to return false if the command should preserve the existing logs.
      Returns:
      true if logs should be cleared, false otherwise
